[EN] Those Crag Stalkers have been a real problem, jumping on anyone that walks past.

I remember when I could have walked around outside and appreciated the beauty.

It's just not true anymore.
[ES] Esos Crag Stalkers han sido un verdadero problema, saltando sobre cualquiera que pasa caminando.

Recuerdo cuando podía caminar por el exterior y apreciar la belleza.

Simplemente ya no es así.
